info.title: ilspycmd
info.description: Command-line decompiler using the ILSpy decompilation engine

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: dotnet tool for decompiling .NET assemblies and generating portable PDBs

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version of ICSharpCode.Decompiler used.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help information.

options.name: --outputdir
options.description: The output directory, if omitted decompiler output is written to standard out.

options.name: --project
options.description: Decompile assembly as compilable project. This requires the output directory option.

options.name: --type
options.description: The fully qualified name of the type to decompile.

options.name: --member
options.description: The single member to decompile: an XML documentation id string (e.g. "M:System.String.Concat(System.String,System.String)", as also accepted by the UI's --navigateto option) or a metadata token (e.g. 0x06000005).

options.name: --ilcode
options.description: Show IL code.

options.name: --il-sequence-points
options.description: Show IL with sequence points. Implies -il.

options.name: --generate-pdb
options.description: Generate PDB.

options.name: --use-varnames-from-pdb
options.description: Use variable names from PDB.

options.name: --list
options.description: Lists all entities of the specified type(s). Valid types: c(lass), i(nterface), s(truct), d(elegate), e(num)

options.name: --list-resources
options.description: Lists all embedded resources in the assembly. Entries inside .resources containers are listed individually as '<container>/<entry>'.

options.name: --resource
options.description: Extract a single resource by name (as printed by --list-resources). Resources whose name ends with '.baml' are decompiled to XAML.

options.name: --decompile-baml
options.description: When used with -p, decompile BAML resources to XAML files (Page items) instead of leaving them as raw byte streams.

options.name: --dump-table
options.description: Dump a metadata table: prints RID, token, names, heap offsets and coded indexes of every row. <table> is the ECMA-335 table name (e.g. TypeDef, Property, MethodSemantics; case-insensitive) or table number (decimal or 0x-prefixed hex, e.g. 0x17).

options.name: --json
options.description: Output as JSON. Currently only supported together with --dump-table.

options.name: --languageversion
options.description: C# Language version: CSharp1, CSharp2, CSharp3, CSharp4, CSharp5, CSharp6, CSharp7, CSharp7_1, CSharp7_2, CSharp7_3, CSharp8_0, CSharp9_0, CSharp10_0, CSharp11_0, CSharp12_0, CSharp13_0, Preview or Latest [default: Latest]

options.name: --ilspy-settingsfile
options.description: Path to an ILSpy settings file.

options.name: --decompiler-setting
options.description: Set a decompiler setting. Use multiple times to set multiple settings.

options.name: --referencepath
options.description: Path to a directory containing dependencies of the assembly that is being decompiled.

options.name: --ignore-decompilation-errors
options.description: Exit with success even when parts of the assembly could not be decompiled. The affected code carries the error text in the output and the failures are listed on stderr either way; only the exit status changes.

options.name: --no-dead-code
options.description: Remove dead code.

options.name: --no-dead-stores
options.description: Remove dead stores.

options.name: --dump-package
options.description: Dump package assemblies into a folder. This requires the output directory option.

options.name: --nested-directories
options.description: Use nested directories for namespaces.

options.name: --disable-updatecheck
options.description: If using ilspycmd in a tight loop or fully automated scenario, you might want to disable the automatic update check.

options.name: --generate-diagrammer
options.description: Generates an interactive HTML diagrammer app from selected types in the target assembly - to the --outputdir or in a 'diagrammer' folder next to to the assembly by default.

options.name: --generate-diagrammer-include
options.description: An optional regular expression matching Type.FullName used to whitelist types to include in the generated diagrammer.

options.name: --generate-diagrammer-exclude
options.description: An optional regular expression matching Type.FullName used to blacklist types to exclude from the generated diagrammer.

options.name: --generate-diagrammer-report-excluded
options.description: Outputs a report of types excluded from the generated diagrammer - whether by default because compiler-generated, explicitly by '--generate-diagrammer-exclude' or implicitly by '--generate-diagrammer-include'. You may find this useful to develop and debug your regular expressions.

options.name: --generate-diagrammer-docs
options.description: The path or file:// URI of the XML file containing the target assembly's documentation comments. You only need to set this if a) you want your diagrams annotated with them and b) the file name differs from that of the assembly. To enable XML documentation output for your assembly, see https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/xmldoc/#create-xml-documentation-output

options.name: --generate-diagrammer-strip-namespaces
options.description: Optional space-separated namespace names that are removed for brevity from XML documentation comments. Note that the order matters: e.g. replace 'System.Collections' before 'System' to remove both of them completely.

options.name: --generate-diagrammer-json-only
options.description: Whether to generate a model.json file instead of baking it into the HTML template. This is useful for the HTML/JS/CSS development loop.

arguments.name: ASSEMBLY FILE NAME(S)
arguments.description: The list of assemblies that is being decompiled. This argument is mandatory.
